privasi.poin1: Client-side image processing runs entirely inside your browser's memory. Your images never leave your local device.
privasi.poin2: When server operations are enabled, images are only sent temporarily for in-memory computation and immediately discarded after the response finishes. We never store your images on disk or database.
privasi.poin3: Zero personal tracking, user accounts, or third-party analytics.

unggah.ajakan: Upload an Image to Start Processing
unggah.petunjukSeret: Drag and drop an image file here, or click the button below
unggah.infoBatas: Supports JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP • Max 10 MB • Max 4096 px dimension • Up to 16M pixels

kanvas.labelSlider: Before and after image comparison slider

panel.kosongOperasi: Select an image operation to view and adjust parameters.
panel.kosongParameter: Select an operation from the left panel to begin tuning processing parameters.
panel.infoSatuOperasi: One active operation at a time (applied directly to original image).
panel.peringatanBatasDimensiDeskripsi: Input values exceed maximum limit ({{maksSisi}} px per side or {{maksTotal}} total). Effective dimensions are clamped to {{lebar}} × {{tinggi}} px to prevent out-of-memory.

kecerahan.deskripsi: Adjust overall lightness or darkness of the image

kontras.deskripsi: Enhance the difference between light and dark regions

negatif.deskripsi: Invert all photometric pixel intensity values

grayscale.deskripsi: Convert color image to grayscale using Rec.601 standard weights

flip.deskripsi: Reflect image orientation horizontally or vertically

rotasi.deskripsi: Rotate image by multiples of 90, 180, or 270 degrees

crop.deskripsi: Crop a rectangular sub-region by numeric coordinates

ubahUkuran.deskripsi: Resample image dimensions using pure geometric interpolation

pisahKanal.deskripsi: Isolate Red, Green, or Blue channel in colored or grayscale mode

ruangWarna.deskripsi: Decompose image into HSV color space channels or Grayscale

saturasi.deskripsi: Adjust the intensity and richness of color hues

hue.deskripsi: Rotate color angle along the HSV color spectrum circle

sepia.deskripsi: Apply a warm vintage sepia photographic tone

balance.deskripsi: Independently adjust gains for Red, Green, and Blue channels

ekualisasi.deskripsi: Flatten pixel intensity CDF distribution to boost global contrast

pereganganKontras.deskripsi: Normalize min-max dynamic range with percentile clipping

gamma.deskripsi: Adjust non-linear power-law photometric luminance response
